events.title: The End of the Hundred Years' War
events.text: At Castillon in Gascony, Jean Bureau's artillery shattered the last English field army on the continent. Only Calais remains in English hands; {country} now faces the task of healing a century of war.

options.label: Proclaim peace and rebuild the royal domain
Keep the Compagnies d'Ordonnance ready for Calais

events.title: The Bitter Peace of Gascony
events.text: Word of John Talbot's defeat in Aquitaine has stunned Westminster. With France triumphant across the Channel, {ruler} faces mounting anger at court and murmurs of Yorkist discontent.

options.label: Retreat into quiet devotion and retrenchment
Vow to reclaim the French inheritance

events.title: The Wars of the Roses
events.text: Rival branches of the House of Plantagenet — Lancaster's red rose and York's white — have drawn swords over the throne of {country}. Nobles muster retainers across the shires while the crown totters.

options.label: Rally the royal Lancastrian banner
Compromise with the Duke of York's council
Summon foreign mercenaries to awe both factions

events.title: The Spider King's Centralisation
events.text: Breaking the great feudal appanages by intrigue and royal ordinance, the French crown seeks to curb rebellious dukes and draw taxes straight into royal coffers.

options.label: Centralise justice and curb the princes
Confirm the peers' ancient liberties

events.title: The League of the Public Weal
events.text: Alarmed by Paris's growing power, Burgundy and the great French lords have formed the League of the Public Weal to defend feudal autonomy.

options.label: Lead the League against royal tyranny
Seek a quiet accommodation with Paris

events.title: The Bold Duke's Ambitions
events.text: Seeking to weld his scattered Netherlandish and Burgundian lands into a middle kingdom from the North Sea to the Alps, the Duke of {country} marches toward Lorraine and the Swiss cantons.

options.label: Press the siege of Nancy — fortune favours the bold!
Consolidate our wealthy Flemish cities first

events.title: The Burgundian Inheritance
events.text: With Charles the Bold's line broken or imperilled, both Paris and the House of Habsburg claim the rich provinces of the Low Countries and Franche-Comté.

options.label: Press Maximilian's marriage claim to Burgundy
Leave the western marches to France

events.title: Caravels Beyond Cape Bojador
events.text: From his base in the Algarve, Prince Henry the Navigator dispatches lateen-rigged caravels down the West African coast, bringing ivory, pepper, and gold to {capital}.

options.label: Fund further voyages down the Guinea coast
Keep our ships close to the Maghrebi straits

events.title: The Marriage of Isabella and Ferdinand
events.text: The secret wedding of Isabella of Castile and Ferdinand of Aragon in Valladolid promises to bind the two great Christian crowns of Iberia against rivals at home and abroad.

options.label: Celebrate the Iberian Union of Crowns
Guard Castilian independence from Aragonese counsel

events.title: The War of the Castilian Succession
events.text: Following the death of Henry IV, rival claimants backed by Lisbon and Aragon contest the Castilian throne across the meseta and the Atlantic islands.

options.label: Secure the crown by sword and royal cortes
Conciliate the grandees with sweeping pardons

events.title: The Tribunal of the Holy Office
events.text: Seeking religious uniformity across newly united realms, {country} petitions Rome for a royal tribunal to root out heresy and enforce orthodoxy.

options.label: Establish the Inquisition under royal authority
Rely on gentle preaching by parish bishops

events.title: The Final Campaign for Granada
events.text: For decades the Emirate of Granada has clung to the Sierra Nevada behind steep mountain passes. Now {country} stands poised to end Moorish rule in Iberia once and for all.

options.label: Press the siege of Granada!
Demand tribute and bide our time

events.title: The Capitulation of the Alhambra
events.text: With Granada already fallen into Christian hands, the royal court must decide whether to honour the generous surrender terms promised to the Mudéjar inhabitants or press immediate conversion.

options.label: Honour the Capitulation of Santa Fe
Order baptisms and unify the realm's faith

events.title: A Genoese Mariner at Lisbon
events.text: Christopher Columbus lays charts before the Portuguese court, claiming he can reach Cipangu and the Indies by sailing west across the Ocean Sea — in return for titles, a tenth of all wealth, and three ships.

options.label: Decline — our mathematicians trust the Cape route
Fund Columbus's western voyage from Lisbon!

events.title: Columbus Seeks a Patron
events.text: Rejected by Lisbon, the Genoese navigator Christopher Columbus arrives at court with bold plans to sail westward across the Atlantic to reach the spice lands of the East.

options.label: Sponsor the expedition from Palos de la Frontera!
Dismiss the adventurer as a dreamer

events.title: A Desperate Navigator Offers His Charts
events.text: Rebuffed by both Iberia's crowns, Christopher Columbus now hawks his transatlantic charts to northern and Italian courts, promising a new ocean highway to Cathay.

options.label: Back the Genoese mariner's fleet!
Keep our fleets in familiar waters

events.title: The Treaty of Tordesillas
events.text: With rival Iberian sails crossing the Atlantic, the Pope brokers a meridian line dividing the newly found seas and spice lands between Castile and Portugal.

options.label: Ratify the meridian and safeguard our Brazil & Indies claims
Reject any limit on Portuguese sea lanes

events.title: Vasco da Gama Reaches Calicut
events.text: Rounding the Cape of Storms and crossing the Indian Ocean with a Gujarati pilot, Vasco da Gama's carracks drop anchor off Calicut, opening a direct sea route from Europe to India's pepper markets.

options.label: Establish a feitoria and challenge the Red Sea spice trade
Trade peacefully under the Zamorin's customs

events.title: The Peace of Lodi
events.text: Exhausted by decades of mercenary wars across Lombardy and Romagna, Milan, Venice, and Florence gather to forge the Italic League, balancing Italy's great powers against foreign invasion.

options.label: Sign the Italic League at Lodi
Keep a free hand in Lombardy

events.title: The Printing Presses of Mainz
events.text: Bitter episcopal rivalry has erupted into the Sack of Mainz, driving Johannes Gutenberg's trained printers across Germany and Italy — carrying movable type into every great market town.

options.label: Protect the workshops and patronise printed books
Let the master printers scatter to wealthier cities

events.title: Death of Ladislaus the Posthumous
events.text: At just seventeen, King Ladislaus V has died suddenly in Prague while preparing his wedding. The personal union binding Hungary, Bohemia, and Austria dissolves overnight as magnates and estates scramble for crowns.

options.label: Mourn the young king and summon the Diet at Buda
Secure the royal castles before rivals move

events.title: Matthias Corvinus and the Black Army
events.text: Elected on the frozen Danube with Ladislaus V dead, the Hungarian crown builds a standing professional mercenary host — the Fekete Sereg — backed by royal taxation to hold the southern frontier.

options.label: Raise the Black Army and reform royal taxes
Rely upon the traditional noble banderia

events.title: George of Poděbrady Elected King
events.text: With the Habsburg-union throne vacant in Prague, the Bohemian estates turn to their native Utraquist governor George of Poděbrady, champion of the Basel Compacts.

options.label: Uphold the Hussite Compacts and crown a national king
Placate Rome with promises of Catholic unity

events.title: Death of Alfonso the Magnanimous
events.text: Alfonso V's passing splits his Mediterranean empire: Aragon, Sicily, and Sardinia pass to his brother, while Naples passes to his illegitimate son Ferrante amid baronial unrest.

options.label: Crush the Angevin barons and secure Naples
Buy the barons' loyalty with feudal privileges

events.title: Lorenzo the Magnificent's Florence
events.text: Under Medici patronage, Florence's workshops, banks, and scholars shine as the heart of the Italian Renaissance, drawing artists and humanists from across Christendom.

options.label: Lavish patronage upon scholars and builders
Guard the Medici bank's liquid reserves

events.title: The Pazzi Conspiracy
events.text: During High Mass in Florence's Duomo, rival Pazzi bankers backed by Roman factions strike at the Medici brothers with concealed daggers.

options.label: Hang the conspirators and defy Rome's interdict
Seek papal absolution through quiet diplomacy

events.title: Savonarola and the Bonfire of the Vanities
events.text: As French armies cross the Alps, the Dominican friar Girolamo Savonarola preaches apocalyptic repentance in Florence, burning luxury books and paintings in the Piazza della Signoria.

options.label: Bow to the Piagnoni republic of virtue
Restore secular order and arrest the friar

events.title: The Prussian Confederation and Thorn
events.text: The towns and gentry of Prussia have risen against Teutonic rule, offering their allegiance to the Polish crown for access to the Vistula grain trade and Baltic ports.

options.label: Incorporate Prussia and claim Danzig!
Respect the Teutonic Order's Baltic charter

events.title: The Struggle for Negroponte and the Morea
events.text: Ottoman fleets and land armies press hard against Venice's Stato da Màr in the Aegean. The Serenissima must decide whether to pour its treasury into the fleet or buy trading peace.

options.label: Arm the Arsenal and hold our island fortresses
Negotiate commercial tribute with the Porte

events.title: The French Claim to Naples
events.text: Tracing Angevin blood rights south of the Alps, Paris prepares a grand artillery train to march down the Italian peninsula, threatening to shatter the Peace of Lodi.

options.label: Cross the Alps with culverins and gendarmes!
Focus French arms on the Rhine and Flanders

events.title: The Stockholm Bloodbath
events.text: Seeking to crush Swedish separatism inside the Kalmar Union once and for all, the Danish crown holds a ruthless trial of Stockholm's magnates and bishops.

options.label: Strike down the Sture party to awe the north
Convene a conciliatory Kalmar council instead

events.title: Luther's Ninety-Five Theses at Wittenberg
events.text: An Augustinian friar named Martin Luther nails Ninety-Five Theses against indulgences to the castle church door in Wittenberg. Printed pamphlets carry his challenge across Europe within weeks.

options.label: Shelter the reformer and let debate spread
Condemn the theses and submit to Rome

events.title: The Ninety-Five Theses at Wittenberg
events.text: Though Saxony no longer rules the Elbe, the monk Martin Luther's protest against indulgences erupts at Wittenberg university, igniting the Reformation across Christendom.

options.label: Let the printing presses carry the debate
Enforce papal decrees in Wittenberg

events.title: The Diet of Worms
events.text: Summoned before the Imperial estates at Worms, Martin Luther refuses to recant his writings. The Empire now stands divided between Catholic loyalists and Evangelical princes.

options.label: Issue the Edict of Worms condemning the heresy
Grant religious peace to keep the princes united

events.title: The Siege of Belgrade
events.text: Ottoman hosts and river galleys close around the great fortress of Belgrade, key to the Hungarian plain. John Hunyadi and Friar Giovanni da Capistrano lead a crusading relief force down the Danube.

options.label: Break the Ottoman siege lines under Hunyadi!
Hold the inner citadel and preserve the Danube fleet

events.title: The Gateway of the Danube
events.text: With Belgrade already flying the Ottoman crescent, {country} fortifies the confluence of the Sava and Danube as a launchpad into Central Europe.

options.label: Turn Belgrade into an imperial frontier fortress
Settle frontier raiders along the Sava river

events.title: Skanderbeg's Bastion in the Highlands
events.text: From his mountain stronghold of Krujë, Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg rallies the League of Lezhë, bleeding Ottoman expeditions in ambush after ambush.

options.label: Defend Albania's passes to the last sword!
Accept Ottoman tributary peace to spare the valleys

events.title: The Ottoman March on Trebizond
events.text: After sweeping across northern Anatolia, Ottoman columns and galleys descend on the Pontic Alps. The last remnant of the Komnenoi Empire at Trebizond faces an impossible choice.

options.label: Bar the gates of Trebizond and defy the Sultan!
Surrender Trebizond in exchange for honourable estates

events.title: The Legacy of Pontic Trebizond
events.text: With the Komnenian throne of Trebizond already extinguished, {country} integrates the Pontic Black Sea port and its Greek and Laz merchants into the imperial customs network.

options.label: Grant Pontic merchants imperial trading charters
Garrison the Pontic passes with timariots

events.title: The Ottoman Landing at Otranto
events.text: Crossing the Strait of Otranto with a grand fleet, Gedik Ahmed Pasha's soldiers storm the Apulian coast near Lecce, sending shockwaves to Rome and across all Italy.

options.label: Rally an Italian crusade to retake Otranto!
Fortify the Apulian hinterland and appeal to Aragon

events.title: Footing Across the Adriatic
events.text: Holding the Apulian shore around Lecce, Ottoman commanders weigh whether to push further into southern Italy or consolidate the Adriatic crossing.

options.label: Fortify Otranto as a bridgehead into Italy
Withdraw the expedition across the strait with plunder

events.title: Mehmed II's Kanunname and New Imperial Capital
events.text: Rebuilding ruined Konstantiniyye with Topkapı Palace, the Grand Bazaar, and the Sahn-ı Seman madrasas, Mehmed II codifies the imperial Kanunname governing state, court, and succession.

options.label: Promulgate the Kanunname and repopulate the Queen of Cities
Pour treasury into the Janissary hearth and siege foundries

events.title: The Flight of Cem Sultan
events.text: Following Mehmed II's death, his younger son Cem contests the Ottoman throne before fleeing to Rhodes and Christendom, becoming a diplomatic hostage in European and Mamluk hands.

options.label: Pay the Knights of Rhodes to keep Cem under watch
Demand Cem's unconditional surrender by threat of arms

events.title: The Night Attack at Târgoviște
events.text: Refusing further tribute to the Porte, Wallachia's Voivode Vlad III launches a daring nocturnal raid straight through the Sultan's Danube camp, inspiring awe and terror across the Balkans.

options.label: Scorch the borderlands and strike at night!
Resume Danube tribute to spare the boyars' estates

events.title: Stephen the Great at Vaslui
events.text: Outnumbered in the foggy marshes of Vaslui, Voivode Stephen III lures a vast Ottoman host into crossfire, earning Pope Sixtus IV's praise as the Champion of Christ.

options.label: Hold the Moldavian marshes and build stone monasteries!
Seek peaceful border demarcation with the Porte

events.title: The Great Siege of Rhodes
events.text: Hundreds of Ottoman sails darken the waters off Rhodes as Mesih Pasha lands heavy siege cannons against the Hospitaller walls. Grand Master Pierre d'Aubusson mans the breach in person.

options.label: Stand fast at the Tower of St. Nicholas!
Treat with the Porte for safe evacuation

events.title: The Fall of Genoese Kaffa
events.text: Ottoman warships under Gedik Ahmed Pasha appear off the Crimean port of Kaffa, ending Genoese rule on the Black Sea and drawing the Crimean Khanate into Ottoman orbit.

options.label: Ally with the Sublime Porte against Genoa and the Steppe
Guard Crimean independence from both Porte and Horde

events.title: The Twilight of Lord Novgorod the Great
events.text: Divided between pro-Lithuanian boyars and Muscovite sympathisers, the wealthy merchant republic of Novgorod faces Moscow's armies across the Shelon river.

options.label: Silence the veche bell and claim Novgorod's lands!
Content ourselves with Novgorodian silver tribute

events.title: The Great Stand on the Ugra River
events.text: Refusing to bow to Khan Akhmat's demand for Tatar tribute, Grand Prince Ivan III marches Muscovite handgunners and cannon to the banks of the Ugra, breaking two centuries of Golden Horde suzerainty.

options.label: Tear up the khan's charter — Russia is sovereign!
Pay one final gift to avoid a winter campaign

events.title: Showdown with the Mamluk Sultanate
events.text: Border clashes in Cilicia and Syria and Mamluk harbouring of Ottoman rivals push Constantinople and Cairo toward a decisive struggle for the Levant and the Holy Cities.

options.label: March south into Syria with our field artillery!
Preserve the Syrian frontier through diplomacy

events.title: Uzun Hasan and the Aq Qoyunlu Ascendancy
events.text: Uniting the White Sheep Turkmen confederation from Diyarbakir to Azerbaijan, Uzun Hasan seeks Venetian cannon and alliances to rival both Qara Qoyunlu and the Ottoman Empire.

options.label: Forge an anti-Ottoman league with Venice and Karaman
Secure peace on the Anatolian frontier and focus on Persia

events.title: The Qizilbash of Ardabil
events.text: Under Shaykhs Junayd and Haydar, the Sufi brotherhood of Ardabil transforms from quiet mystics into the crimson-capped Qizilbash ghazis, preaching devotion across Azerbaijan and eastern Anatolia.

options.label: Let the Qizilbash marchers gather in Azerbaijan
Arrest the shaykh's lieutenants and watch the shrines

events.title: Ismail Safavi Proclaims the Shahdom
events.text: Emerging from Ardabil at the head of devoted Qizilbash tribesmen, young Ismail enters Tabriz and proclaims Twelver Shi'ism the state faith of a reborn Persian realm.

options.label: Proclaim Twelver Shi'ism and crown the Qizilbash Shah!
Suppress the Qizilbash coup and uphold Sunni orthodoxy

events.title: The Eastern Frontier and Chaldiran
events.text: Alarmed by Qizilbash preachers stirring Turkmen tribes across Anatolia, the Ottoman Sultan musters Janissary musketeers and chained field guns for a gruelling march into Azerbaijan.

options.label: March east with gun-wagons to break the Qizilbash!
Seal the mountain passes and patrol Anatolia

events.title: Muhammad Shaybani Khan and Samarkand
events.text: Riding south from the Kipchak steppe, Muhammad Shaybani Khan's Uzbek horsemen sweep across the Syr Darya, challenging the fractured Timurid princes of Transoxiana.

options.label: Ride for Samarkand and claim Transoxiana!
Raid the frontier oases and hold the steppe

events.title: Babur's Rise at Kabul
events.text: Driven from Fergana and Samarkand by Uzbek conquests, the young Timurid prince Zahir al-Din Muhammad Babur crosses the Hindu Kush and seizes Kabul as his new base of empire.

options.label: Turn south toward Hindustan and train matchlockmen!
Fortify Kabul and look back toward Samarkand

events.title: The First Battle of Panipat
events.text: Armed with Ottoman-style matchlocks and lashed artillery wagons, Babur's Kabul host descends through the Khyber Pass toward Panipat to confront the Afghan Sultanate of Delhi.

options.label: Unleash the wagon-laager cannon on the road to Delhi!
Exact border tribute from the Punjab governors

events.title: Qaitbay's Citadel and the Spice Monopoly
events.text: Under Sultan Qaitbay, Cairo raises soaring stone domes and tightens royal control over the Karimi spice trade flowing from the Red Sea to Alexandria's Venetian fondaci.

options.label: Enforce the Sultan's spice monopoly and build Qaitbay's fort
Grant lower customs to Alexandrian burghers and Venice

events.title: Naval Showdown in the Arabian Sea
events.text: With European carracks seizing spice fleets off Malabar and threatening the Red Sea, Cairo equips a joint war-galley armada with Gujarati and Ottoman aid to contest the Indian Ocean.

options.label: Sail a Red Sea war fleet to Diu!
Strengthen Suez and Jeddah against oceanic raids

events.title: Bahlul Lodi Consolidates Hindustan
events.text: Rallying Afghan clans from Sirhind and Lahore, Sultan Bahlul Lodi defends Delhi against the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur and rebuilds the authority of the Delhi Sultanate.

options.label: Reward the Afghan maliks and press Jaunpur
Reform the crown's revenue registers in the Doab

events.title: Rana Kumbha's Victory Tower at Chittor
events.text: Master of fortress architecture, music, and war, Maharana Kumbha raises the soaring Kirti Stambha at Chittor and strengthens Mewar's hill forts against Gujarat and Malwa.

options.label: Raise the Victory Tower and fortresses of Kumbhalgarh
Muster the Rajput clans for border raids

events.title: Mahmud Begada of Gujarat
events.text: Capturing the hill citadels of Girnar and Champaner, Sultan Mahmud Begada extends Gujarati maritime prosperity across the Gulf of Cambay.

options.label: Patronise maritime trade and coastal forts
Expand the royal war-elephant stables

events.title: Golden Age of Vijayanagara
events.text: Under the Tuluva emperor Krishnadevaraya, Vijayanagara's courts ring with Telugu and Sanskrit verse while Portuguese Arabian horses mount its shock cavalry across the Deccan.

options.label: Patronise the Ashtadiggajas poets and royal cavalry
Secure war-horses from coastal traders

events.title: The Husain Shahi Renaissance in Bengal
events.text: Restoring order across the Ganges delta, Alauddin Husain Shah welcomes Bengali scholars, builds brick mosques and temples, and expands Bengal's muslin and rice exports.

options.label: Foster Bengali letters and delta trade
Strengthen riverine war-fleets on the Padma

events.title: The Council of Debre Berhan
events.text: Summoning bishops and monks to Debre Berhan, Emperor Zara Yaqob settles Ethiopia's Sabbath controversy, strengthens the royal chewa garrisons, and sends envoys toward Christendom.

options.label: Enforce church reform and centralise crown authority
Grant autonomy to northern monastic houses

events.title: Ahmad Gragn's Banner in the Horn
events.text: Uniting Somali and Harari warriors under the title of Imam, Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi acquires matchlocks from the Red Sea ports and prepares to challenge the Ethiopian highlands.

options.label: Proclaim the highland campaign!
Consolidate Zeila's Red Sea customs first

events.title: Rebels Take Up Arms in {province}!
events.text: Banners of revolt have been unfurled in {province}: {rebels} have risen {men} strong against the crown of {country}. Local magistrates beg for immediate orders.

options.label: Dispatch the royal host to crush the rebels
Offer local tax relief to calm the countryside
Muster an emergency town militia in the capital

events.title: Poison in the Cup: {victim} Murdered!
events.text: Tragedy strikes the court of {country}! {victim} has been slain by poison in a conspiracy orchestrated by {plotter}. The realm looks to {ruler} for justice or calm.

options.label: Denounce the traitor and rally loyal houses
Hush the scandal to spare the dynasty's name

events.title: Murder Plot Uncovered!
events.text: Your spymaster has intercepted coded letters and poisoned phials: {plotter} conspired against the life of {victim}. Their estates have been seized for the crown; how shall the court respond?

options.label: Seize their titles and warn every magnate
Show calculated clemency and exact a heavy fine

events.title: The Crown Passes to {ruler}
events.text: {old_ruler} has passed from this world, leaving the realm of {country} to {ruler}. Nobles, clergy, and burghers gather at {capital} for the accession ceremonies.

options.label: Observe dignified mourning and steady the realm
Hold a lavish coronation to awe rivals
Confirm the estates' charters to heal unrest
